create_world_instance: create a World instance with opts and spec dict containing players, mobs, items, and coord_shift
place_block_in_world: place a block at a given XYZ location with an IDM tuple in the World
dig_block_at_location: dig a block at a given XYZ location by calling World.dig with the coordinates
get_blocks_in_bounds: get a numpy array of blocks within specified XYZ bounds using World.get_blocks
get_line_of_sight: get the line of sight position from a given pos, yaw, and pitch using World.get_line_of_sight
